description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the variable N and AUC (%) across five distinct data series. The x-axis is labeled "N" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "AUC (%)" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 75 to 100, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. A solid blue line with open circle markers begins at approximately N=1 with an AUC of 94%, rises to 101% at N=5, reaches 103% at N=10, and continues a gradual upward trend to end at approximately 104% at N=20. A solid red line with open square markers starts at N=1 with a value of 87%, increases to a peak of 103% at N=10, dips slightly to 101% at N=15, and finishes at 102% at N=20. A solid green line with open star markers begins at N=1 at 86% and exhibits a steady upward trend across the x-axis, passing through 93% at N=5, 98% at N=10, and 102% at N=15, before ending at 103% at N=20. A solid yellow line with open diamond markers starts at N=1 with an AUC of 84%, rises sharply to 95% at N=5, and continues to increase steadily to end at approximately 105% at N=20. Finally, a solid purple line with open downward-pointing triangle markers begins at N=1 at 80%, increases slightly to 82% at N=5, experiences a sharp peak to 102% at N=10, declines to 94% at N=15, and remains steady to end at 94% at N=20.
